verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox's first-party docs say it provides a real street address that meets business registration requirements in most states, and position it as a professional alternative to a home address and to a P.O. Box. A customer testimonial describes using it to establish a business address. missing for 10: any evidence of acceptance for bank KYC, explicit coverage of vendor forms, clarity on which states don't accept it for registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
